ex: an idle student
懒散的学生

zh: the fact of tending to be lazy and not work hard
the fact of not having work or of not being in use
en: the fact of tending to be lazy and not work hard
ex: It was sheer idleness that I never pursued this enquiry.
我从来没有去过这个询问，这是纯粹的无聊。

en: a person who is lazy and does not work
an Indian rice cake cooked using steam (= gas produced when water boils)

zh: 毫无目的地；漫不经心地；闲散地
en: without any particular reason, purpose or effort; doing nothing
ex: She sat in the sun, idly sipping a cool drink.
她坐在阳光下懒洋洋地抿着冷饮。

zh: an artificial language developed from Esperanto
en: an artificial language developed from Esperanto

zh: 受到热爱和崇拜的人（或物）；偶像
en: a person or thing that is loved and admired very much
ex: a pop/teen idol
流行/青春偶像

zh: having or showing too much love or praise for somebody/something
en: connected with the practice of worshipping statues as gods
ex: Praying to an image was regarded as idolatrous.
向图像祈祷被认为是偶像崇拜。

en: the practice of worshipping statues as gods
ex: football fans whose support for their team borders on idolatry
对球队几乎到了盲目崇拜地步的足球迷

zh: great love and praise for somebody, possibly too much
en: great love and praise for somebody, possibly too much
